newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission prepares new auditing strategy.
newsitem.headline: Commission prepares new auditing strategy.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday the European Union needed a new approach to statutory auditing, but that it should take place through cooperation and coordination rather than legislation.
"The new approach to auditing would be based on close cooperation between the accounting profession and Member State representatives...," the Commission said in statement IP/96/1134.
The EU's single market Commissioner Mario Monti said after a two-day conference last week there was a need to prevent the international standard setters dictating terms to the EU.

"The EU cannot simply give carte blanche to the international standard setters. The EU must organise itself in such a way that it can ensure that International Standards on Auditing correspond to what we want to apply in the Single Market," he said in the statement.
The conference brought together 200 professionals and public authorities in the statutory auditing sector.
Participants said that many problems facing the EU's auditing sector related to the lack of an agreed framework for the statutory audit.
